Author: Subhash Chandra Sharma
Bench: Subhash Chandra Sharma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 82
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1167 of 2023
Applicant :- Amit Shukla

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Karan Singh Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.

This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking bail in Case Crime No. 38 of 2022, under sections 376, 511, 323, 504, 506, 498A I.P.C. & Section 3/4 D.P. Act,
Police Station Bahariya, District Prayagraj.
It is submitted that in this case applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated being devar of the informant.

Further submitted that in F.I.R. allegation of molestation was made against the present applicant whereas the allegation of harassment of the informant was made against all the family members including the husband of the informant.
It is further submitted that the present F.I.R. was lodged on account of mutual dispute between husband and wife for making pressure on his family.

It is also submitted that during investigation the informant exaggerated her allegation Amit Shukla vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141565284/
1 and stated that present applicant also made attempt to commit rape with her though F.I.R. was lodged by the informant herself but no any such allegation was made in the F.I.R.

sentences.text: Now investigation is going on and the applicant is under apprehension of imminent arrest.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he would not misuse the liberty of bail and would cooperate with the investigation.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A., perusal of record, the allegation made in the F.I.R. and the statement made by the victim and without making any comment on the merit of the case, the applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail in this case for the limited period considering the exception considered by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC Online SC 98.
